titulo_es: Expression of an action prior to a previous action

texto: When you tell something that happened in prossimo passage and you need to explain a fact that had already been consumed before, you resort to the trapassate: **Quando sono andata al cinema, avevo già comprato il biglietto**.
The **già** (already) warning is usually placed between the auxiliary and the participle: **avevo già letto**, **era già partita**.

filas: Ho visto il film ieri sera.
First he read the book, then he saw the movie.
They had eaten before they went to the restaurant.

frases.it: Claudia, andiamo al cinema stasera? Hanno aperto una nuova sala in centro.
frases.es: Claudia, ¿vamos al cine esta noche? Han abierto una nueva sala en el centro.
frases.en: Claudia, are we going to the movies tonight? They've opened a new room in the center.

frases.it: Purtroppo ho già visto quel film! Ci ero andata martedì scorso con mia sorella.
frases.es: ¡Por desgracia ya vi esa película! Había ido allí el martes pasado con mi hermana.
frases.en: Unfortunately, I've seen that movie! I had gone there last Tuesday with my sister.

frases.it: Che peccato! Pensavo che non fossi ancora andata.
frases.es: ¡Qué lástima! Pensaba que todavía no habías ido.
frases.en: What a shame! I thought you hadn't gone yet.

frases.it: Avevo letto la recensione su internet e avevo comprato il biglietto subito.
frases.es: Había leído la reseña en internet y había comprado la entrada enseguida.
frases.en: He had read the review on the Internet and had bought the entry right away.

bloques.pregunta: Why doesn't Claudia go to the cinemas with Matteo?

opciones.texto: Because he had already gone to his sister's last Tuesday.
opciones.explicacion: The previous action in trapassate («ci ero andata») explains its rejection.

opciones.texto: Because he doesn't have the money to buy the ticket.
opciones.explicacion: Claudia already bought and used her entry earlier.

opciones.texto: Because the center room is still closed.
opciones.explicacion: Matteo clarifies that they have just opened a new room.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the right form of «avere».
bloques.frase: Claudia non è venuta perché ___ già visto quel film al cinema.

opciones.explicacion: With «lei» (Claudia) subject in trapassate corresponds «aveva visto».
«Ha visto» is prossimo passage and does not express before the past.
He's a third person of plural, but the subject is singular.

bloques.pregunta: What does Claudia say in this sentence?

opciones.texto: He had bought the entrance immediately after reading the review.
opciones.explicacion: «Subito» expresses immediacy and «avevo comprato» previously consumed.

opciones.texto: I'm going to buy the entry right now on the Internet.
opciones.explicacion: The action has already taken place entirely in the past.

opciones.texto: I never buy tickets to the cinema on the Internet.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the consummate fact exposed by Claudia.

bloques.frase: Avevo già letto la recensione del film su internet
bloques.traduccion: I had already read the film's review on the Internet.
bloques.explicacion: Trapassate with the «già» warning interspersed after the auxiliary.

bloques.pregunta: Where is the «già» warning normally placed in the composite times?

opciones.texto: Between the conjugated auxiliary and the past participle.
opciones.explicacion: It is the canonical placement: «avevo già visto», «ero già arrivato».

opciones.texto: Always at the absolute end of the subordinate sentence.
opciones.explicacion: In the end it is forced or unidiomatic.

opciones.texto: In front of any articulated preposition.
opciones.explicacion: The fixed position is after the auxiliary verb.

bloques.frase: Quando Matteo ha telefonato, Claudia era ___ uscita di casa.

opciones.explicacion: «Era già uscita» states that the output preceded the phone call.
It would change the meaning towards «I've never been out before.».
With «ancora» it would require prior denial («non era ancora uscita»).

bloques.pregunta: What role does «ci» play in this sentence?
bloques.frase: Ci ero andata martedì scorso con mia sorella.

opciones.texto: It replaces the place mentioned above (the cinema room).
It works as a direct pronoun masculine singular.
opciones.explicacion: The direct pronoun masculine would be «lo».

opciones.texto: It indicates a reciprocal reflecting action between two people.
opciones.explicacion: Here «andare» is intransitive with a sense of place to the cinema.

intro: The prossimo trapassate places an action at a time point prior to another event in the past. It is the key tool for giving chronological depth to any account.
